{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders again
total_rows = len(df)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check final population
print(f"Final number of orders (after removing QA and refunded): {len(filtered_df)}")"}
